## Proof of Done

<!-- Required for every issue. Keep this section last and include it at the end of your final completion comment on the PR as well. Replace the prompts with actual evidence; update after revisions. -->

- **Acceptance criteria:** Map each criterion to implemented behavior and concrete evidence (files or reviewer-accessible artifacts).
- **Verification:** List checks actually performed and their results. State skipped checks, unverified services and remaining limitations.
- **Screenshots:** Embed or link screenshots with captions when they meaningfully demonstrate the change, especially visible UI changes. Cover relevant states/viewports; use before/after images when helpful. Remove secrets, personal data and unrelated browser/application content. If screenshots add no value, briefly explain why.
